description: A painted scene under a large spreading tree. A man in a tan campaign hat and khaki uniform, with a machete at his side, stands center-left gesturing, facing a white-haired older man in a dark navy uniform with gold epaulettes and red trousers who sits at a small table. Behind the standing man, a group of armed men in khaki hold rifles, and more officers in dark blue uniforms stand behind the seated man. The setting is an outdoor grove with dappled light and leaf litter on the ground. No visible text, frame or border; the painting fills the image edge to edge.
